◆ The story behind the brand

Built by a student.
Worn by anyone who moves.

Jadeite was born out of a frustration Jad Rbii knew all too well — spending hours training, but never finding gymwear that felt both premium and purposeful. Every option was either a fast-fashion knockoff or a legacy brand charging luxury prices for mediocre quality.

At 17, based in Dubai, Jad decided to stop waiting for someone else to solve it. He spent months researching the global activewear market, interviewing peers across the UAE, and studying the gap between what Gen Z athletes needed and what the industry was offering.

The result is JADEITE — a brand rooted in craft, compression, and clarity. Designed for people who take their training seriously, but also want to look good outside the gym.

01

Identified the gap

No brand was designing premium gymwear for young, style-conscious athletes at an accessible price point — especially in the GCC.

02

Researched the market

Surveyed 200+ peers. Analysed 12 competitor brands. Studied supply chains, fabric technology, and consumer psychology across 6 months.

03

Built the brand

Designed the product range, created the visual identity, launched the website, and prepared JADEITE for its first public drop — all before graduating.

◆ Research & Insights

The data behind the drop.

Before designing a single piece, Jad spent six months researching the activewear landscape — market size, consumer behaviour, competitor weaknesses, and the specific demands of the Gen Z athlete.

Global activewear market
$600B+
Projected market size by 2030, growing at 6.7% CAGR — one of the fastest-growing segments in fashion.
Gen Z dissatisfaction
73%
Of surveyed 16–22 year olds said existing gymwear brands don't reflect their identity or values.
Price sensitivity
$55–$85
The sweet spot — what young athletes are willing to spend for quality activewear, per Jad's 200-person survey.
MENA opportunity
$8B
Estimated UAE + GCC premium sportswear market — massively underpenetrated by emerging independent brands.

What the market offers

  • Fast-fashion gymwear that loses shape after 10 washes
  • Legacy brands (Nike, Lululemon) at prices teens can't afford
  • Generic colourways — black, grey, navy — nothing distinctive
  • No brand rooted in the GCC or designed for that climate
  • Poorly constructed seams that chafe during training
  • Marketing that ignores young, male gymwear consumers
VS

What JADEITE delivers

  • Premium compression fabrics engineered to hold shape long-term
  • Mid-premium price point: quality without the legacy markup
  • Signature jade-inspired palette — distinctive and wearable
  • Designed with the Dubai athlete and UAE market in mind
  • Bonded seams and four-way stretch for unrestricted movement
  • Inclusive range — women's and men's from day one

◆ Published Research

Beyond the field.

Jad's work extends beyond clothing. In June 2026, his academic research was published in the International Journal of Scientific Development and Research (IJSDR, Vol. 11, Issue 6).

IJSDR2606041 · June 2026 · Volume 11 Issue 6

Personal Branding in Student-Athletes: Its Influence on Opportunities and Recruitment in Modern Sports Ecosystems

This paper explores how personal branding affects recruitment and opportunity creation for student-athletes, particularly within European and Middle Eastern sports ecosystems. The study examines the role of social media presence, athlete storytelling, image management, highlight reels, and digital engagement in shaping perceptions among coaches, scouts, universities, and sports organisations.

Findings suggest that effective personal branding significantly improves recruitment opportunities in highly competitive sports markets — and that personal branding has become an essential professional skill for modern student-athletes alongside athletic performance.

Personal Branding Sports Recruitment Digital Identity Athlete Marketing Social Media

Published in the International Journal of Scientific Development and Research (IJSDR) · ISSN: 2455-2631 · www.ijsdr.org

◆ Help

Shipping & Delivery

Standard Shipping

Free standard shipping on all orders over $80. Orders under $80 are charged a flat shipping fee at checkout. Standard delivery takes 5–10 business days depending on your location.

Express Shipping

Express shipping via DHL is available at checkout for all destinations. Estimated delivery 2–4 business days. Express rates are calculated at checkout based on your location.

Where We Ship

JADEITE ships worldwide. All orders are dispatched from Dubai, UAE. Customs duties and import taxes may apply depending on your country — these are the responsibility of the recipient.

Processing Time

Orders are processed within 1–2 business days. You will receive a shipping confirmation email with tracking details once your order has been dispatched.

Tracking Your Order

Once dispatched, you will receive a tracking number by email. You can also track your order directly on this site — Track Order →

◆ Help

Returns & Exchanges

30-Day Returns

We offer free returns within 30 days of delivery, from anywhere in the world. Items must be unworn, unwashed, and returned in their original packaging with tags attached.

How to Return

Email us at returns@jadeite.com with your order number and reason for return. We will provide a prepaid return label within 24 hours. Drop your parcel at any courier collection point.

Exchanges

We are happy to exchange for a different size or colour, subject to availability. Contact us before initiating a return and we will reserve your preferred item.

Refunds

Refunds are processed to your original payment method within 5–7 business days of us receiving your return. You will receive a confirmation email once the refund has been issued.

Non-Returnable Items

Items marked as Final Sale or Limited Edition at the time of purchase are non-returnable. If you are unsure, contact us before purchasing.

◆ Company

Sustainability

Made to Last

Every JADEITE piece is made from heavyweight 280–380 gsm cotton — built to outlast trends and fast fashion cycles. We design for longevity, not disposability. Fewer, better pieces is our model.

Made in Dubai

All JADEITE garments are produced in Dubai with oversight at every step. Local production means shorter supply chains, reduced emissions, and direct quality control. We know exactly who makes our clothes.

Limited Runs

We produce in small, intentional quantities. No overproduction, no surplus, no waste. Each collection is a limited drop — when it's gone, it's gone. This keeps our footprint small and our product meaningful.

What's Next

We are actively researching organic and recycled cotton options for future collections, as well as carbon-neutral shipping partnerships. Sustainability is a journey — we will share updates as we progress.
